study: Requirements Classification Evidence Triage on a Gold-Standard Benchmark
finding: Classification quality is heterogeneous across the five evaluated labels. A gold-label oracle can concentrate 51.9% of all label errors into 100 items, but that is an upper bound rather than a deployable policy. A prediction-only pattern-rarity heuristic captures 115 of 534 errors (21.5%) in the top 100, versus 17.5% expected under uniform random review (1.23× enrichment).
source: eTour requirements-classification benchmark and NoRBERT predictions from the FTLR replication package
